name: Heaven
description: God's court, styled with explicit monarchical imagery -- deliberate per Milton's own political subtext (docs/milton/milton-biography.md §7). Site of the War in Heaven and the Son's pre-emptive volunteering to redeem mankind (Book III).
demographics: God the Father, the Son, loyal angels (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Abdiel and others)
power_structure: Absolute monarchy under God the Father -- this book's narrative POV frames it as a slaveholding regime (docs/planning/TFAH-brief.md §8); the nonfiction apparatus does not endorse this as settled Milton scholarship.
